g.text: Legend (SysML v2 action flow view): rounded box = action (name : its action definition, here the kind of task, which
says who may do it); small squares = parameters (in on the entry side, out on the exit side); filled circle = start,
bull's eye = done, diamond = decide; open arrow = succession with [guard]; thick filled arrow = flow of an item.
